description: This file defines functions and types for managing tool policy pipelines, including building default steps, applying policies to tools, and warning about unknown allowlist entries. It handles policy resolution, filtering tools based on policies, and warning cache management.

methods.name: buildDefaultToolPolicyPipelineSteps
methods.description: Constructs an array of policy pipeline steps based on provided profile, provider, agent, and group policies.

methods.name: applyToolPolicyPipeline
methods.description: Filters a list of tools according to a sequence of policy steps, applying allowlists, plugin groups, and warnings.

methods.name: resetToolPolicyWarningCacheForTest
methods.description: Clears the cache of warning messages to reset warning state during tests.
